before_2018.note: 50%: Ley 17/2012 DA 13a as enacted, for journeys to the rest of the national territory; the RD 949/2018 preamble and the 2018-07-13 agreement both cite it

current.note: 75%: Ley 17/2012 DA 13a apartado Tres; raised from 50% under the authority of Ley 6/2018 DA 147a by the Council of Ministers agreement of 2018-07-13 (BOE 2018-07-14) and Real Decreto 949/2018

alpha_periods.source: Ley 17/2012 (BOE 2012-12-28), DA 13a apartado Tres as enacted: 50 por ciento, trayectos con el resto del territorio nacional así como en los viajes interinsulares. For Canary residents the provision was annulled by STC 164/2014 (BOE 2014-10-29), the nullity deferred one year, and re-enacted by Ley 40/2015, DF 10 (in force 2015-10-03, DF 18.3), with its first paragraphs taking effect from 2013-01-01, so the share runs unbroken; the re-enacted text drops the ministerial power to cap the subsidised fare
Ley 3/2017 (BOE 2017-06-28, in force the next day, DF 35a), DA 128a rewriting DA 13a apartado Tres: 50 por ciento por cada trayecto directo, y en los viajes interinsulares será del 75 por ciento

Ley 6/2018 DA 147a; Council of Ministers agreement of 2018-07-13 (BOE 2018-07-14, a Saturday; tickets issued from 09:00 on the day of publication if it is a working day, so from Monday 2018-07-16, the date the press reports); Real Decreto 949/2018

config.excluded_letters: Ley 21/2003 art. 68.2 d), e), f): security, passenger, PMR
not_modelled: article 2.5 cap on higher-class fares (needs the registered basic fare)
taxes on the fare, which sit in the base and are the same share on every segment of one tax territory

criteria.detail: every departure cell carries the page and row of the tariff guide it is read from, and every square is computed twice, as a ratio of the two resident factors and from the written-out product, which share no helper. Unsourced cells: none. Squares where the two paths differ: none of 231. The guide prints every charge to the cent, a fixed published format, so the arithmetic is exact and a zero is decided without a tolerance.
criteria.name: B125-S1

criteria.detail: the statute writes one share alpha per class (resident, non-resident) and a base that leaves out three charges the airport operator writes per departure airport; the two classes buy the same seat under the same fare; the class edge is a crossing only the traveller can make. Missing on record: none.
criteria.name: B125-S2

criteria.detail: the registered reading is that the deduction of letters d), e) and f) alone makes the resident factor depend on the departure airport, so a square at one airline fare is non-zero exactly when the excluded share U / f differs between the two cells. Read at alpha = 3/4: 908 of 924 (square, fare) cells non-zero; 16 zero, and every zero falls where the excluded shares are equal (unexplained: 0). Smallest and largest non-zero log: 0.000019, 0.567940.
criteria.name: B125-S3

criteria.detail: the bare scalar field puts one price on one seat whoever buys it. Read: 88 of 88 (cell, fare) class gaps differ from one.
criteria.name: B125-S4
criteria.rival_entailment: phi carries no class index, so a resident and a non-resident pay the same on every segment
criteria.rival_premise: P(r, class) = phi(r): one seat on one segment has one price

criteria.detail: the separable rival lets the class enter as one proportion on every segment, which is what a 75% discount on the whole ticket would be, and it makes every square exactly one. Read: 908 of 924 (square, fare) cells differ from one. With two different fares on the two segments a square closes only when the fares stand in the ratio of the excluded charges; that ratio is printed per square (closing_ratio_fare_2_over_1), and the rival needs every airline to price every pair of segments on it on every date.
criteria.name: B125-S5
criteria.rival_entailment: the resident factor is exp(psi(R) - psi(N)) on every segment, so the ratio of that factor across two segments, which is the square, is one
criteria.rival_premise: log P(r, class) = phi(r) + psi(class): the class changes the price by one proportion on every segment

criteria.detail: on the Canary Islands public service obligation routes the fare is published, so the square is read at the state's own reference fare instead of on a grid: 13 routes, both directions, each at its reference fare with the departure airport's inter-island charges. Read at alpha = 3/4: 320 of 325 squares non-zero; zeros the excluded share U / f does not explain: 0.
criteria.name: B125-S7

criteria.detail: article 2.5 as administered (annex IV: the basic-fares file serves to check the maximum subsidy on each coupon), so a flexible fare above the basic fare is subsidised only up to alpha times the basic fare. On the Canary Islands routes, with the basic fare read as the reference fare and the flexible fare at its 130% ceiling, the square of reference against flexible fare, resident against non-resident, is non-zero on 26 of 26 route-directions, and the cap binds (the square differs from the uncapped one) on 26; with no airport charges it is (1 + m - alpha)/((1 + m)(1 - alpha)), written by the cap alone. The separable rival, one class proportion on every product, predicts one.
criteria.name: B125-S8

criteria.detail: the separable rival on the class side: at one route-direction the price of four classes, age (young, adult) by residence, is a route term plus an age term plus a residence term in logs, so their class square is zero. Read at the published reference fares and the statutory minimum social discounts (Balearic Islands 20% for residents only, Canary Islands 10% for everyone in the age bands): 32 of 32 route-directions non-zero (Balearic Islands 6, Canary Islands 26).
criteria.name: B125-S9
criteria.rival_entailment: the ratio young over adult is the same for residents and non-residents, so the class square at every route-direction is one
criteria.rival_premise: log P(route, age, residence) = phi(route) + psi(age) + chi(residence)

criteria.detail: the two archipelagos write the age axis differently, and the class square shows it. With the airport charges set to zero the Balearic square is still non-zero on every route-direction (6 of 6; log -0.223144 = log 0.8, because the age discount is written for residents only), while the Canary square is exactly one on every one (26 of 26: two class-only discounts that multiply). There it opens only through the airport charges, which neither discount touches.
criteria.name: B125-S10

criteria.detail: each cell's tariff section, passenger, security and PMR amounts are printed into the record beside the provisions and the fare grid. Missing: none; cells: 22.
criteria.name: B125-S6

law.alpha_rule: Ley 17/2012, DA 13a, apartado Tres: 75 por ciento de la tarifa por cada trayecto directo, y en los viajes interinsulares asimismo del 75 por ciento
law.base_rule: Ley 17/2012, disposición adicional décima tercera, apartado Tres (texto consolidado; párrafo final añadido por la disposición final 16 de la Ley 8/2013): del importe de la tarifa del servicio regular de transporte se deducirá el importe correspondiente a las prestaciones patrimoniales públicas a que se refieren las letras d), e) y f) del artículo 68.2 de la Ley 21/2003, con independencia de que hayan sido repercutidas o no al pasajero
law.class_edge: residence is certified per person against the municipal register and the ticket is nominative, checked against identity at boarding; the crossing is the traveller's own and nobody can make it for another (D30, fourth clause: a crossing only oneself can make)
law.excluded_now: Ley 21/2003, art. 68.2 (redacción de la Ley 18/2014): d) inspección y control de pasajeros y equipajes (the guide's 'Seguridad'); e) puesta a disposición a los pasajeros de las instalaciones aeroportuarias no accesibles a los visitantes (the guide's 'Pasajeros'); f) movilidad general de los pasajeros y asistencia a PMRs (the guide's 'PMR'). The guide's section 2.2 definitions repeat letters d), e) and f) word for word. Real Decreto 1316/2001 art. 2.4 names only the first two; the law governs
law.same_object: resident and non-resident buy the same seat on the same flight under the same fare conditions; the discount is applied to that fare (D49: the reading depends on route and fare, and those are equal)

osp_canarias.cap_rule: Real Decreto 1316/2001, anexo IV, fichero de tarifas básicas: necesarias para la comprobación de los topes máximos de subvención aplicable a cada cupón facturado

rule.source: Orden FOM/1085/2008 (BOE-A-2008-6924), apartado 2.3 c), unchanged by Orden TRM/1406/2024 and Orden TRM/395/2025: tarifas sociales con un descuento mínimo del 20% respecto de la tarifa de referencia para jóvenes menores de veinticuatro años y personas que hayan cumplido los sesenta y cinco años, categorías de pasajeros residentes en las Islas Baleares
